attributes.title: 2027 Annual Assembly of Hospice and Palliative Care
attributes.series: Annual Assembly of Hospice and Palliative Care
attributes.cme_provider: Hospice and Palliative Nurses Association (nursing CE)
attributes.organizer: American Academy of Hospice and Palliative Medicine
attributes.summary:
The 2027 Annual Assembly of Hospice and Palliative Care is held March 17 to 20, 2027, at the David L. Lawrence Convention Center in Pittsburgh. It is presented jointly by AAHPM and the Hospice and Palliative Nurses Association, and draws more than 2,500 hospice and palliative care clinicians. It is an in-person meeting; an Assembly On-Call package sells the recordings.

Registration is open. Physician members of AAHPM or HPNA pay $1,030 through January 13, 2027 ($1,293 after), non-member physicians $1,545 ($1,931); member nurses pay $767 ($968) and non-member nurses $998 ($1,220). One-day and on-call options are cheaper. HPNA is the ANCC-accredited provider of nursing contact hours; the number of CME credits and contact hours for 2027 is not published yet. Credit claims close June 30, 2027.
